value.description: The machine-readable envelope of a 401 or 429: a stable code and its message.

patches.why: The spec's Error schema names only `message` and `info`, but currencyapi's status-code page says 401 and 429 answers carry an `error` object with a stable `code` and `message` (https://currencyapi.com/docs/status-codes, "Error response body"), and its own 401 example prints one; a request with no key to the API's /v3/latest answered it on 2026-09-27 (`"error":{"code":"missing_api_key","message":"No API key found in request"}`).

source.quote: responses instead carry a machine-readable envelope

value.description: Next-step URLs for a 401 or 429 (get_free_api_key, sign_up, docs).

patches.why: The same page: 401 and 429 answers carry "an `actions` object with next-step URLs", and its 401 example prints `get_free_api_key`, `sign_up` and `docs` (https://currencyapi.com/docs/status-codes); the live 401 of 2026-09-27 carried the same three.

value.description: A monthly-quota 429's account of the month: its limit, what is used and remaining, and when it resets.

patches.why: The same page: "Monthly-quota `429` responses additionally include a `quota` object with `limit`, `used`, `remaining` and `resets_at`; minute rate-limit `429` responses do not" (https://currencyapi.com/docs/status-codes). The spec's Error schema lacks it.

currencyapi's status-code page: "The rates endpoints also return a 404 when there is no data for your requested timeframe and accuracy" (https://currencyapi.com/docs/status-codes); historical data starts in 1999 (https://currencyapi.com/docs/historical: "Data are available all the way back to 1999"). The spec lists no 404 for the rates endpoints.

patches.why: As for historical: a convert against a date with no data answers the rates endpoints' 404 (https://currencyapi.com/docs/status-codes).
